Subject: Quick ask: sandbox exemption for Axon Apps integration

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for taking time last week. We're on a tight integration timeline with a large retail customer who requires an early functional sandbox (no production listing) so they can finish end-to-end testing before our marketplace listing window next quarter.

Specifically, we're asking if Redwood can approve a temporary sandbox exemption so Axon can:
- Get a short-lived API key tied to a sandbox account with up to 50k monthly tokens for testing.
- Have a test SSO / SAML flow we can exercise with our customer's staging environment.
- Access a staging model variant (non-quantized) for parity with production behavior.

We attached our sandbox requirements doc (axons_sandbox_requirements.pdf). If this is possible we'd like to lock the dates: June 1 — July 15, with the sandbox shut down automatically afterwards.

Can you confirm who on your side needs to sign off (security/marketplace/legal), and whether this would impact our official marketplace onboarding timeline?

Appreciate the help — Devon
Devon Lee
Product & Partnerships, Axon Apps
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Quick ask: sandbox exemption for Axon Apps integration

Thanks Devon — good context and helpful attachment. Looping in partner engineering (Jonas) and marketplace (Vanessa) to scope the ask.

A couple quick clarifying questions from product/ops:
1) Is the requested API key scoped to a single Axon tenant (yes/no)?
2) Do you need any special kv-cache / model-pin behavior, or is a standard "staging model" sufficient?
3) Will any customer PII be sent to the sandbox environment during tests? If so, what masking controls will you use?

From Redwood's perspective we typically treat sandbox exemptions as timebound, with a technical isolation checklist and a short addendum to the partner terms. Vanessa — can you confirm the gating criteria we should evaluate? Jonas — can you estimate the engineering effort for a sandbox account + SSO test integration?

I'll coordinate sign-offs once we have those answers.

Best,
Grace O'Connor

Appreciate the note. From a commercial/sales perspective:
- This is aligned with an active deal (HubSpot: HS-4521) — the customer has requested a staging window as part of their procurement checklist.
- Legal will likely ask for a short addendum that limits token usage, duration, and liability; we can use the proposed_exemption_addendum.docx as a starting point.

Devon — can you confirm whether the customer will cover any incremental infra spend? Also copying Grace — we should set an internal deadline for sign-off to avoid blocking the June 1 start.

Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 09:15:42 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: sandbox exemption for Axon Apps integration

Thanks — I reviewed the requirements quickly and sketched an onboarding checklist (attached: sandbox_onboarding_checklist.xlsx). High-level notes:
- We can spin up a timebound sandbox tenant with a test API key and SAML test provider. No dedicated GPU required for 50k tokens/month.
- Staging model parity: we can provide a non-quantized variant, but model pinning will be read-only (cannot persist custom kv-cache across restarts).
- Data controls: we require that any PII be pseudonymized; if the customer wants real production data, we need a signed data-processing addendum and additional logging controls.

Estimated effort:~3 engineering days for tenant provisioning + 1 day for SSO test integration and validation. If we need custom routing or dedicated capacity the estimate increases.

Quoted for context: 
> On Thu, 19 Apr 2028 at 09:12 Devon Lee wrote:
> > We're asking if Redwood can approve a temporary sandbox exemption so Axon can:
> > - Get a short-lived API key tied to a sandbox account with up to 50k monthly tokens for testing.

Next steps I suggest: Jonas/Grace/Karthik to approve checklist -> Vanessa to open exception Jira for marketplace gating -> engineering to schedule provisioning (target: provision by 2028-05-20).

-Jonas
Principal Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference

Couple marketplace compliance notes:
- Temporary sandbox access is generally allowed but we need a Jira exception so PM/Legal can track deviations from normal gating. I'll open PRT-1024 and tag Legal & Security.
- Exemption should not alter the public listing status; Axon will still need to complete the marketplace listing checklist for the production release.
- Billing: if the sandbox uses shared resources, no billing change; if dedicated, we need a PO or cost pass-through.

Devon — please confirm if Axon will accept the standard short addendum or if Legal needs custom language. Also confirm whether the staging tenant requires any special entitlements that would affect marketplace SKU mapping.
